verses.english: 3. The Explanation of the Hundred and Eight

verses.pali: Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imāsaṁ tissannaṁ vedanānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ nappajānanti …pe…
verses.english: There are ascetics and brahmins who don’t truly understand these three feelings’ origin, disappearance, gratification, drawback, and escape. …

verses.pali: pajānanti …pe… sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī”ti.
verses.english: There are ascetics and brahmins who do truly understand …”
